crossRefs.note: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
crossRefs.keyword: nobles held their peace. Heb. voice of the nobles was hid.their tongue

crossRefs.note: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, that you will be mute, and will not be able to correct them…
